text:
QUOTE: "**Three server errors remove the post instead:** `DELETED_ROOT_POST_ERROR`, `TOWN_SQUARE_READ_ONLY_ERROR`, and `PLUGIN_DISMISSED_POST_ERROR` call `removePost`, so the user never sees a failed post."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names all three errors (deleted root post, read-only town square, plugin-dismissed post) as causing the post to be removed rather than kept as failed.
